vibe_rationale: 25-year independent festival rooted in Raglan's surf-town community, with a community-trusted feel and a narrower music scene.
fit_notes: Teens and young adults with a large under-18 share, so the adult health audience is thin and the duty-of-care setup will tightly limit brand presence. ZM is the listed presenting brand, so access is closed; it is a New Zealand event.
